items.title: Fabrinet Lost 32% in a Month. Barclays Sees 58% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFabrinet shares fell 32% in the past month as AI optics stocks, including Coherent, Lumentum and Marvell, sold off on fears about AI funding and hyperscaler spending. Fabrinet had no news of its own during the sell-off.

items.title: Tower Semiconductor Sinks 14% in a Week Despite “The Strongest Growth Phase in Our History”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTower Semiconductor fell 14% in the past week, mostly in a chip selloff after Intel’s weak forecast that also hit Lumentum and Coherent. Tower then posted record third-quarter revenue, up 33%, and guidance above estimates.

items.title: Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold AAOI Stock Ahead of Q3 Earnings?
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics' AI-driven demand and capacity expansion fuel growth prospects ahead of Q3 earnings, but supply constraints and valuation pose risks.

items.title: Should COHR Stock Be in Your Portfolio Before Q1 Earnings?
items.summary: Coherent's Q1 earnings outlook signals strong revenue and profit growth, fueled by AI-driven optical networking demand, but valuation risks remain.

items.title: Coherent Rallies 6% Ahead of Earnings as Optical Stocks Rebound; Applied Optoelectronics Gains 5%, Lumentum Ticks Up
items.summary: Optical stocks are bouncing back sharply, but Coherent faces a pivotal earnings report tomorrow that could either vindicate the rebound or expose how fragile the recovery really is.

items.title: Coherent Soars 6% as Fabrinet’s 51% Revenue Jump Lifts Optics Stocks Ahead of Earnings
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares rose 6% today after Fabrinet reported a 51% revenue jump and guided above Wall Street’s forecast. Fabrinet’s data center revenue grew 78%, close to the more-than-80% growth Coherent guided for its own data center sales.

items.title: Is Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) Outperforming Other Business Services Stocks This Year?
items.summary: Here is how Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) and Coherent (COHR) have performed compared to their sector so far this year.

items.title: Marvell and Lumentum Fell Hard. Their Supplier’s Stock Is Soaring
items.summary: When Marvell announced a blockbuster acquisition and both stocks tanked, one overlooked supplier quietly posted the best quarter in its history after hours. The question now is whether that record run can survive the deal's fallout.
